about.title: About New Textile Social Company Limited
about.hero_subtitle: Rwanda's leading destination for premium textiles, curtains, fabrics, and traditional attire.
about.story_p1: New Textile Social Company Limited, known as DENISE, was founded with a vision to bring premium quality textiles to Rwandan homes and businesses.
about.story_p2: We specialize in curtains, curtain rods and accessories, Rwandan traditional attire, fabrics for clothing, and interior decoration materials.
about.story_p3: Our unique approach allows customers to browse our extensive collection online, reserve their favorites, and visit our Kigali store to inspect, confirm, and complete their purchase – ensuring complete satisfaction with every buy.
about.mission_desc: To bring premium quality textiles to every home and business in Rwanda — at a fair price, with honest advice, and service worth coming back to.
about.vision_desc: To be the first name Rwandans think of for curtains, fabrics and traditional attire, in every province of the country.
about.value1_desc: We source only the finest textiles for our customers
about.value2_desc: Supporting Rwandan artisans and local craftsmanship
about.value3_desc: Proudly based in Kigali, serving all of Rwanda
about.value4_desc: Exceptional personalized service for every customer
